name: Presence (CR +2)
body:
Not all outsiders materialize as physical beings, treading upon the material plane to actively exert their will. In many circumstances, the influence of the outer planes is more subtle, with champions manifesting as figments to guide mortal races from a distance. Presences are particularly common among the Imperatives, who employ them on ideologically hostile worlds to covertly correct a nation’s ideological course.

Presence is an acquired or inherited template which can be applied to any outsider with the extraplanar subtype, hereafter referred to as the base creature. It uses abilities as the base creature, with the following modifications.

Challenge Rating: As base creature +2.

Type: The presence gains the incorporeal subtype.

Defensive Abilities: A presence retains all of the defensive abilities of the base creature save those that rely on a corporeal form to function. Presences are immune to dazing, disease, exhaustion, fatigue, paralysis, poison, sleep effects, and stunning, as well as all effects that require a corporeal body. They are not subject to nonlethal damage. A presence does not risk death from damage, but instead immediately dissipates when its hit point total drops to a negative amount equal to its Constitution score. A presence gains the incorporeal ability as well as the following defensive abilities.

Fortified Essence (Su)

The deflection bonus to AC granted by the presence’s incorporeal subtype is equal to the presence’s Charisma modifier.

Weaknesses: A presence gains the following weakness:

Body of Convictions (Su)

Any weapon aligned to the opposite of the presence’s alignment (for example, chaos-aligned weapons for lawful presences) counts as a ghost touch weapon for the purpose of damaging the presence.

Speed: A presence gains a fly speed equal to its land speed (minimum 30 feet) with perfect maneuverability.

Special Attacks: A presence gains the following special attacks:

Planar Touch (Su)

A presence gains an incorporeal touch attack which deals 1d6 points of damage plus an additional 1d6 for every 3 Hit Dice the presence possesses. If the target is of an alignment opposite the presence (evil for any good presence, for example, or lawful for any chaotic presence), the damage dice increase from d6 to d10.

Special Qualities: A presence gains the following special qualities:

Phantom Armaments (Su)

A presence can imbue any weapons, shields, or armor it carries with the ghost touch special ability.

This effect lasts for as long as the presence wields them and for 1 minute thereafter. The presence uses these items as if it had a Strength score equal to its Charisma score.

Ability Score Modifiers: Dex +4, Con +4, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +4. As an incorporeal creature, a presence has no Strength score.
